summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Operations page UI refactoring. All 13 features tested and working correctly. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: OperationsPage.js is 919 lines - consider splitting NotionTable, CellEditor, SelectCell, MultiSelectCell, PersonCell, and TemplateModal into separate component files for better maintainability
seed_data_creation: Created 'Test Content Calendar' database from Content Calendar template during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operations page UI refactoring complete and tested. All features working: 1) Database tabs at top showing all databases, 2) Tab switching works, 3) Add Task button creates new rows with toast notification, 4) Search input filters tasks, 5) Quick status filter chips (All, Planning, In Progress, Review, Completed) work, 6) More Filters button expands Advanced Filters panel, 7) Priority filter dropdown in advanced filters, 8) Assignee filter dropdown in advanced filters, 9) Date range filters (Due After, Due Before) in advanced filters, 10) New Project button opens template modal, 11) Creating database from template works (tested with Content Calendar), 12) Inline cell editing works in table, 13) Sidebar shows databases nested under Operations with direct links. Test data created: 'Test Content Calendar' database, 'Test Task Name' task in Website database.
